description: Run automated checks on a live website or web app to detect potential legal, accessibility, privacy, consumer law, security, SEO and speed issues. Use when the user is about to launch, publish or deploy a site, or asks if it is legal, compliant, accessible or ready to go live. Returns an inspection ID; then call get_launch_inspection. Free: up to 5 pages, 3 a day. A licence key unlocks up to 25 pages and full explanations; on a site the user has verified (verify_site), it also runs the security checks. Reports on sites the user does not own are private, labelled unverified, and never include security testing. The inspector honours robots.txt opt-outs.

business_type.description: Optional. One or more of: consultancy, personal-services (hair, beauty, tattoo), trades, health, hospitality, retail, digital (SaaS, apps, courses), creative (music, art), fitness-events, kids-education, regulated-pro (finance, legal, real estate), nonprofit, marketplace. Join two with "+", e.g. "creative+retail". Leave out to detect it.

max_pages.description: Optional. Pages to check (free: up to 5).

url.description: The public website address, for example https://example.com

name: start_launch_inspection
title: Start a launch inspection
